preconditions.description: The number of towns n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n and a[i] != i for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each road must connect to a valid town and cannot connect to itself.
The length of the list of roads must equal the number of towns.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of valid road configurations modulo 10^9 + 7.
